summary: by charlotte is a Rosebery NSW designer jewellery brand, founder-owned and self-funded, that has scaled from one Paddington store to 16 stores plus online and wholesale. Adam Blogg joined as Director of Finance & IT in March 2026 and shared a May 2026 hiring post for his team at a pivotal point in the growth journey. Its LinkedIn tech profile shows Shopify Plus, Shopify POS, Xero, Workday and Employment Hero, and an ERP rollout was described in 2024.

hooks.text: Adam's May 2026 hiring post and repost of store openings 15 and 16: the finance team is scaling with the store network.
Store rollout from one store to 16 plus online and wholesale means POS takings and card settlements per store.
Adam's cash and working capital background suggests he will respond to close-time leakage framing.

risks.text: Adam started in March 2026 and a new ERP/systems agenda may absorb attention; ERP already integrates the business.
Account record flags revenue possibly above the target band; company has grown to roughly 90 staff.
Adam's LinkedIn About still describes a prior Woolworths role, so current-role details rely on the experience entry.

gaps: No podcast or video content found.
ERP vendor not named in sources read.
No direct posts by Adam on reconciliation or close.
